description: A light-dependent resistor: its resistance falls in bright light (about 2 kΩ) and rises in the dark (about 50 kΩ).
how_to_use: Two legs, no polarity. Use it in a voltage divider: one leg to 5V, the other leg to an analog pin AND through a fixed resistor (usually 10 kΩ, the examples also use 4.7 kΩ) to GND. analogRead() then rises with brighter light. Covering it with a hand makes the reading drop.

plain.what: A light sensor: a little disc whose resistance changes with how bright it is.
plain.how: One leg to 5V, the other leg to an analog pin and through a 10 kΩ resistor to GND. The Arduino then reads a bigger number when it's brighter.
